definitions.explanation: A medical condition where poor blood flow to the brain causes cell death, resulting in sudden neurological symptoms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather collapsed from a stroke.

examples.japanese: {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧べきだ。
examples.english: If stroke symptoms appear, you should go to the hospital immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高血圧|こうけつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
examples.english: High blood pressure increases the risk of stroke.

notes:
{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう} is the general medical term for stroke in Japanese.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{脳|のう}→脳：noentry⟧ (brain) + ⟦{卒中|そっちゅう}→卒中：noentry⟧ (sudden attack) = {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}

TYPES:
- ⟦{脳梗塞|のうこうそく}→脳梗塞：noentry⟧ - cerebral infarction (ischemic stroke)
- ⟦{脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}→脳出血：noentry⟧ - cerebral hemorrhage
- くも{膜下|まくか}⟦{出血|しゅっけつ}→出血：11735_shukketsu⟧ - subarachnoid hemorrhage

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧ - to collapse from a stroke
- {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ - stroke prevention
- {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧ - risk of stroke
- {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後遺症|こういしょう}→後遺症：08622_kouishou⟧ - stroke aftereffects

RISK FACTORS:
⟦{高血圧|こうけつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧ (high blood pressure), ⟦{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}→糖尿病：04414_tounyoubyou⟧ (diabetes), ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧ (smoking)
